name: Camp Jordan
description_short: Bangor Region YMCA overnight camp on a 200 acre site on Branch Lake near Ellsworth. In Sleep Away Camp, campers 7 to 15 choose activities such as tubing, kayaking, ropes courses, archery, crafts and performing arts; the camp also runs Mini-Camp, Adventure Seekers, Downeast Adventures and Leaders School.
refund_policy_summary: The $200 deposit per session is not refundable. Cancel in writing by May 1, 2027 for a refund of all other payments; no refunds after May 1 except possible exceptions for injury or illness with a doctor's note.
swim_waterfront_notes: A quarter mile of lakefront on 2,700 acre Branch Lake.
notes: Tiered tuition (full cost, partly subsidized, scholarship subsidized); financial assistance applications accepted until May 17. Multi week, sibling, alumni and referral discounts. Weekend stayover $100.
